parts:

I was wondering where the templates are actually corresponding to js files? for instance i've set up the default /etc/shiny-server/templates/directoryIndex.html and configured the server with directory_index on. It doesn't look so great. I want to customize this page. I can't get my head around where this file in particular is getting access to the title variable in {{title}} or the apps variable in {{#each apps}} or the dirs var in {{#each dirs}}

Just need a quick pointer here

thanks,j
